test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 06 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

F I R _ D F _ _ E D F _ T _ D F I _ E _

options.text: E I S I E U D
E G S J E U E
E H S I E U D
E I S I E U E

solution:
Given : F I R _ D F _ _ E D F _ T _ D F I _ E _

**By checking options :**

 
• E I S I E U D → F I R __**E**__ D - F __**I**__ __**S**__ E D - F __**I**__ T __**E**__ D - F I __**U**__ E __**D**__ → (It Follows the pattern of : )
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d55ee18e0b2801a4edfc9d6f7a8c0b999d4e9d6fe2630661a3d68ba1f282bf5.png] 
 
• E G S J E U E → F I R __E__ D - F **__G__** __S__ E D - F **__J__** T __E__ D - F I __U__ E **__E__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• E H S I E U D → F I R __E__ D - F **__H__** __S__ E D - F __I__ T __E__ D - F I __U__ E __D__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• ​E I S I E U E → F I R __E__ D - F __I__ __S__ E D - F __I__ T __E__ D - F I __U__ E **__E__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (1) gives the pattern of "F I R __E__ D - F __I__ __S__ E D - F __I__ T __E__ D - F I __U__ E __D__"

Hence, "**E I S I E U D**" is the correct answer.
